scope: Production fixed-normal translating plane contact, conservative mesh sample collection, rigid-body response, reactions/work, volume, transactions and checkpoint state. Explicit project full-area wall variant, without restitution or published-benchmark admission.

gates.analytical_sphere_cap: 32768-node force and normal energy relative error <0.1% against independent closed cap integrals
gates.action_reaction: Force and common-origin moment residuals <1e-5 of force and force*0.006m scales
gates.wall_stress: Independent original-node common-point virial error <1e-4 of force*radius/domain_volume
gates.original_node_collection: Rotated box and oblique plane, SDF and hierarchical mesh modes: exact active source keys/counts; force/torque error <1e-4 of force and force*radius scales
gates.moving_wall_work: 100 single steps at 10ns, normal wall velocity +0.1 then -0.1m/s; independent SI trapezoidal work and per-wall/total agreement <1e-5 initial elastic energy; kinetic+proxy balance residual <0.1% initial elastic energy at every observation; zero cell work
gates.restart_and_growth: Continuing friction/restart and automatic capacity-growth states: normalized rtol 2e-4, atol 3e-7; exact untruncated contact count after growth; zero continuing spring after separation and return
gates.rollback: Excess penetration and invalid wall-box gap reject entire chunks; every exported state array bit-identical including plane velocities, residuals, work and history
gates.volume: Moving six-plane box, fixed computational domain; lengths relative error <1e-7, axial engineering strain absolute error <1e-7
gates.laboratory: Explicit wall stage, HDF5 checkpoint/4 retains all plane state, resume completes eight steps, exported boundary and measurement volume remain explicit

regression: All existing serial Metal tests, with unchanged gates
limitations: Prescribed velocities, no inertial walls or force controller
No published assembly or Hostun material acceptance
